infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your camera to record video tours, capture clips, and broadcast live virtual TV sessions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your microphone for high-fidelity audio capture, voice notes, and live call-ins.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your location for mapping, local peer mesh discovery, and emergency dispatch.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your contacts for direct messaging, creator invites, and peer-to-peer connections.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow ChatUP to access your photo library to upload video clips, custom avatars, and media files.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow ChatUP to access your camera for broadcasting and scanning QR codes.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow ChatUP to access your location for mesh networking and mapping features.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow ChatUP to access contacts to connect with friends.
